answer: Weight each attestation by the signer's own record, then split the verdict across two auditors who do not share funding. Every submission carries a fresh nonce, so one clean review cannot be copied to a sibling. A farm has to earn weight on real work before its vouch is worth anything, and every fake it certifies spends that weight. The cipher is the nonce, dawn is the first honest review, and a ferrous stake is what makes the second one count.
